title: AdamMeme: Adaptively Probe the Reasoning Capacity of Multimodal Large Language Models on Harmfulness
reasoning: The paper includes 'Religion' as one of its core evaluation categories for determining the harmfulness of memes. It provides a formal definition for religious harm (including propagating intolerance and misrepresenting practices), uses it as a performance metric for several models, and provides specific qualitative case studies involving religious content.
